chunks: And in the narration of Hisham, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
Regarding a woman who wants to perform hajj and does not have a mahram with her: Is hajj proper for her? He عليه السلام said: "Yes, if she is safe/trustworthy."

key_terms.الْحَجَّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman asking about the ruling
key_terms.مَأْمُونَةً: being in a state of safety and security
key_terms.مَحْرَمٌ: a male relative whom she cannot marry and who may accompany her
key_terms.يَصْلُحُ: is valid or permissible in this legal context

ai.seo_question: Can a woman perform hajj without a mahram according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a woman traveling for hajj without a mahram. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام permits it on the condition that she is ma'munah, meaning that her situation is secure and she is considered safe.
